# altertable_service_account (Resource)

An Altertable service account (machine identity).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "altertable_service_account" "example" {
  label = "CI Deploy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Service account label.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service account identifier.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe service account slug (server-assigned).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = altertable_service_account.ci
  identity = {
    id = "sa_abc123"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import altertable_service_account.ci sa_abc123
```
